svg.title: From AI Use Cases to MCP Use Cases in Healthcare Insurance
svg.desc: A diagram showing how traditional AI use cases in healthcare insurance evolve into MCP-enabled agentic use cases, with examples for claims, prior auth, member services, fraud, and care management.

g.text: Healthcare insurance: from AI use cases to MCP use cases
How point-in-time AI predictions become autonomous, multi-tool agentic workflows

svg.text: • Returns a score, label, or extract
• Human reviews and decides next action
• Integrated into one system of record
• Executes a sequence of real actions
• Triggered by user intent or schedule
• Tested on task accuracy + safety gates
• Governed via EA registry + ARB review
The AI model does not disappear — it becomes one tool inside the MCP agent.
The shift is from returning a prediction to completing a workflow.
